elements.text: Experience:
Velocity IT
Sep 21 to Current Role: DataScientist
Project 1: Pre-screen Calling Agent
Designed and deployed a GenAI-based Patient Pre-screening Agent that engaged patients via
SMS/Email/Twilio integration, and auto-followed up with non-responders.
Leveraged OpenAI LLM, LangChain, AWS Lambda, Claude 3.5 Haiku, Mistral 7B, RAGAS to automate patient eligibility checks and communication.
Result: Increased patient response rates by 42% and reduced manual coordinator workload by 60%.
Project 2: Question Identification System
Built an AI-powered NLP pipeline to detect and eliminate duplicate questions across clinical trial studies, ensuring a clean and standardized knowledge base.
Implemented RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) with FAISS vector database + OpenAI embeddings to enhance duplicate detection accuracy.
Leveraged OpenAI LLM, LangChain, AWS Lambda, Claude 3.5 Haiku, Mistral 7B, RAGAS Project 3: Clinical Trial Adverse Event Classifier
Built an NLP-driven ML pipeline (Logistic Regression, XGBoost, BERT) to classify patient-reported symptoms as Adverse Events vs. Non-Adverse Events .
Standardized reports using MedDRA ontology, handled class imbalance, and engineered temporal/contextual features.
Monitoring (KS Test, PSI) for drift detection and continuous retraining.
Project 4: Automated Patient Condition Extraction from Clinical Conversations

Built an NLP pipeline to classify doctor vs. patient speech in clinical conversations and extract medical conditions (NER + ICD-10 mapping) only from patient statements, auto-filling structured databases.
Used BERT, RoBERTa, DistilBERT,BioClinicalBERT / BlueBERT, ICD-10
Responsibilities:
Utilized Python libraries pandas, numPY
Familiar with JSON based REST Web Services and Amazon Web Services(AWS).
Implemented RAG(Generative AI) to find the similar question in existing question bank
Used prompt engineering(LLM) to find the variance in the similar questions
Used LLM Model to identify medical condition
Used LLm Model to find start date and end date of medical condition
Developed predictive models using Decision Tree, Random Forest and Naïve Bayes and regression techniques
Developed a layer of applications modules over the Python - Pandas library, delivered various data frame visualization tools, Data wrangling and cleaning using Python Pandas.
Performed data cleaning and data processing using Python Data frames.

Extensive experience in Text Analytics, developing different Statistical Machine Learning, Data Mining solutions to various business problems and generating Data. Visualizations using R, Python and Tableau
Developed NLP models for Topic Extraction, Sentiment Analysis.
Work with NLTK library to NLP data processing and finding the patterns.

sections.text:
Project 1: Pre-screen Calling Agent
Designed and deployed a GenAI-based Patient Pre-screening Agent that engaged patients via
SMS/Email/Twilio integration, and auto-followed up with non-responders.
Leveraged OpenAI LLM, LangChain, AWS Lambda, Claude 3.5 Haiku, Mistral 7B, RAGAS to automate patient eligibility checks and communication.
Result: Increased patient response rates by 42% and reduced manual coordinator workload by 60%.
Project 2: Question Identification System
Built an AI-powered NLP pipeline to detect and eliminate duplicate questions across clinical trial studies, ensuring a clean and standardized knowledge base.
Implemented RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) with FAISS vector database + OpenAI embeddings to enhance duplicate detection accuracy.
Leveraged OpenAI LLM, LangChain, AWS Lambda, Claude 3.5 Haiku, Mistral 7B, RAGAS Project 3: Clinical Trial Adverse Event Classifier
Built an NLP-driven ML pipeline (Logistic Regression, XGBoost, BERT) to classify patient-reported symptoms as Adverse Events vs. Non-Adverse Events .
Standardized reports using MedDRA ontology, handled class imbalance, and engineered temporal/contextual features.
Monitoring (KS Test, PSI) for drift detection and continuous retraining.
Project 4: Automated Patient Condition Extraction from Clinical Conversations
Built an NLP pipeline to classify doctor vs. patient speech in clinical conversations and extract medical conditions (NER + ICD-10 mapping) only from patient statements, auto-filling structured databases.
Used BERT, RoBERTa, DistilBERT,BioClinicalBERT / BlueBERT, ICD-10
Responsibilities:
Utilized Python libraries pandas, numPY
Familiar with JSON based REST Web Services and Amazon Web Services(AWS).
Implemented RAG(Generative AI) to find the similar question in existing question bank
Used prompt engineering(LLM) to find the variance in the similar questions
Used LLM Model to identify medical condition
Used LLm Model to find start date and end date of medical condition
Developed predictive models using Decision Tree, Random Forest and Naïve Bayes and regression techniques
Developed a layer of applications modules over the Python - Pandas library, delivered various data frame visualization tools, Data wrangling and cleaning using Python Pandas.
Performed data cleaning and data processing using Python Data frames.
Extensive experience in Text Analytics, developing different Statistical Machine Learning, Data Mining solutions to various business problems and generating Data. Visualizations using R, Python and Tableau
Developed NLP models for Topic Extraction, Sentiment Analysis.
Work with NLTK library to NLP data processing and finding the patterns.
